An admin that merely reaches one Pool setter shouldn't have its capital reach flared to all of them. The ownership is real for governance chains, so scope it to governance-only (backward): keeps the aTokens' owner chains intact, removes the spurious forward capital flare.
Single-edge example: scope just this one ownership edge (PoolInstance → VariableDebtTokenMainnetInstanceGHO.mint) to governance-only, instead of the whole contract.
